title: Quotes
purpose: Find client quotes, latest staff versions, decision states and prices.

sections.title: Access
paragraphs: Project managers and admins can use price lists and quotes. Other staff roles do not grant this access. Admin includes the project manager role. A superuser flag alone supplies no application role.

sections.title: Find and arrange records
paragraphs: There is no bulk action or selection across pages. Invalid filters show errors and no rows; correct or clear them. No matches means the filters found nothing. An unfiltered empty list means no eligible records exist.

items.label: Search
items.description: Search number, current title, client name, project name and client purchase-order/reference. Case-insensitive partial matching trims surrounding spaces and accepts at most 200 characters. Search and filters apply together to the full record set.

items.label: Status
items.description: All statuses initially: Draft, Issued, Being revised, Accepted, Declined and Withdrawn. Expired selects issued quotes past the latest valid-until date. Issued excludes expired quotes.

items.label: Client
items.description: Any client initially; restrict to one client. Inactive clients remain available for existing records.

items.label: Apply
items.description: Apply search and filters and return to page 1. Current sorting and page size are kept.

items.label: Clear all
items.description: Remove search, filters, sorting and page settings and return to this list’s defaults. Removing one active filter keeps the others and returns to page 1.

items.label: Sort
items.description: Newest quote numbers appear first. Select a sortable heading to change direction. Sortable columns: Quote, Client, Project, Title, Status, Total (USD), Valid until and Issued. Sorting applies to all matching records, with record identity as a stable tie-breaker.

items.label: Rows per page
items.description: 25 by default; choose 50 or 100. A change returns to page 1 and preserves other query settings. Show applies the choice without automatic submission.

items.label: First page / Previous page / Next page / Last page
items.description: Move through matching records. The footer shows the visible range, count and page. Unavailable directions are disabled. Invalid page numbers resolve to an available page; unsupported page sizes are refused.

items.label: Columns
items.description: With enhanced controls, show/hide columns and use Move up / Move down or drag headings to reorder. Quote is always shown and fixed. Changes apply immediately and are saved in this browser for this table; they do not filter or change records.

items.label: Reset columns / Done / Close
items.description: Reset columns restores shipped visibility and order. Done or Close dismisses the Columns dialog; changes already apply.

items.label: Quote
items.description: Assigned QT number; select to open the document, versions and actions.

items.label: Client
items.description: Current client name.

items.label: Project
items.description: Optional current project; hidden initially. A dash means none.

items.label: Title
items.description: Current staff title, including unissued revision changes.

items.label: Status
items.description: Current workflow state; Expired is calculated from validity, not saved as a decision.

items.label: Version
items.description: Latest version number, including an unissued draft. Not sortable.

items.label: Total (USD)
items.description: Exact total of the latest version, including an unissued draft.

items.label: Valid until
items.description: Latest version’s date, or a dash if unset.

items.label: Issued
items.description: Latest version’s issue timestamp; blank for a draft. Hidden initially.

items.label: Client reference
items.description: Purchase order/reference recorded at acceptance, or a dash. Hidden initially and not sortable.

items.label: New quote
items.description: Open a header form, then enter prices and terms. Project managers and admins can create quotes; the empty state offers this action.
